title: Due Diligence and Confidentiality | NJMC Medical Supplies
description: How NJMC works: a sourcing, verification and consultancy company, not a manufacturer and not a notified body, with strict confidentiality for clients.
html:
Due diligence

How we work, and what we do not claim

What NJMC is, what it is not, and how we handle your information.

What NJMC is

NJMC Medical Supplies Co., Ltd is a sourcing, trading, verification and consultancy company in Jianye District, Nanjing. We are not a manufacturer. We do not own production facilities and we do not represent a single factory. That independence is deliberate: a shortlist reflects your specification rather than our inventory.

What NJMC is not

NJMC is not a certification body and not a notified body. We do not certify. We verify and check, according to our experience and with experts. Certifications such as CE marking, FDA clearance or SFDA registration belong to the product and its manufacturer, never to NJMC.

How we look at a supplier

We read the certificate of analysis against the specification, ask which site actually manufactured the batch, and check whether the regulatory file supports the filing you intend to make. The manufacturing site has to be the site named on the GMP certificate, not the trading company on the letterhead.

Certificates on request

Where a product or category carries a certification, the certificate is available on request for that product.

Company registration

The business licence is shown below. The code can be checked on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (gsxt.gov.cn).

Confidentiality

We do not publish client names, supplier names, supplier documents, price lists or certificates from supplier files, on this website or anywhere else. What you send us for a quotation or a verification stays between you and NJMC.

For an independent check of a supplier, a shipment or a document set, see Independent Verification.

Talk to NJMC

Send your specification or your question. Technical enquiries are answered by Dr. Qaria directly rather than by a sales desk.
